fields.Name: T88 - Legislative Issue Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Legislative Issue's related Policy Positions or Advocacy Actions can be reached from the full record form and that related rows render.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Legislative Issues' entity from the entity tree. Select 'Dairy Pricing Reform Act' (or any issue) and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full form. On that form, locate the related Policy Positions or Advocacy Actions section/tab and view it, confirming related rows are displayed (or a valid empty-state). Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Legislative Issue full record form is open showing issue detail fields
A related Policy Positions or Advocacy Actions section/tab is visible with related rows (or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
